title: Chapter 243 - 243 Thank You; It’S Good For The Company!

Chapter 243 - 243 Thank You; It’S Good For The Company!

Chapter 243 - 243 Thank You; It’s Good for the Company!

243 Thank You; It’s Good for the Company!

Zhao Haibo had already ordered the dishes. After Lin Fan sat down, fragrant dishes were served.

Although the dishes in front of him were not as sumptuous as yesterday, theystill looked very exquisite. Lin Fan took a light whiff of the fragrance, and he started to drool.

“Liu Gonglu often mentioned you in front of me. Unfortunately, I never had the chance to meet you” Zhao Haibo said.

“In the morning, because I was in a hurry to go to Flower Stem for the discussion, I didn’t have time to chat with you It has made me feel a little regretful.

“Now, we finally have a chance!”

Lin Fan glanced at Liu Gonglu, who had his head lowered. He knew that Zhao Haibo was saying some pretty words. Rather, he was trying to please him.

He had roughly guessed… the reason why the other party was like this.

However, Lin Fan did not point it out. He smiled and said, “Manager Zhao, you’re too polite.”

“This isn’t being polite. I’m speaking from the bottom of my heart!” As Zhao Haibo spoke, he raised his wine glass and said, “Here, let me toast to Mr. Lin first!”

Then, he directly drank the wine in his glass in one gulp.

Lin Fan and Liu Gonglu also drank a glass.

When Zhao Haibo saw this, he became even happier and said, “Speaking of the negotiation with Flower Stem, it’s all thanks to you! Originally, it might have been difficult for our Qingkong Company to obtain the distribution rights this time

“But, Mr. Lin, you let our Qingkong Company become the sole agent for the entire Southern Xia region! Thank you, thank you so much!”

When Zhao Haibo mentioned this matter, his entire face became rosy.

With the popularity of Flower Stem’s perfume and essence, he could already imagine the huge profits that Qingkong Company would earn after becoming the sole agent of the Southern Xia region. He could also imagine the scene of the company praising him and Liu Gonglu.

Thinking of this, Zhao Haibo raised his wine glass again and said, “Mr. Lin, let me toast you again!”

After saying that, he poured another glass of wine into his stomach.

Then, the three of them continued drinking, eating, and chatting. It was very relaxed.

At this moment, Liu Gonglu suddenly said, “Lin Fan, do you know the president of Flower Stem? Why did she make our company the sole agent of the Southern Xia region the moment I mentioned your name”

When Zhao Haibo heard this, his figure straightened slightly, and his ears could not help but perk up.

Obviously, he was also very curious about this question.

It was really This matter was too unbelievable.

“Yeah, I know her,” Lin Fan said casually.

“And the reason why she directly made your company the sole agent of the Southern Xia region is probably… because I’m the biggest shareholder of Flower Stem.”

As soon as he said this, Zhao Haibo and Liu Gonglu suddenly opened their mouths wide and were stunned on the spot.

Flower Stem The biggest shareholder?

If he was the major shareholder of the previous Flower Stem, it would be fine. However, being a shareholder of the current Flower Stem was too amazing!

The biggest shareholder?

How high was his net worth?

Lin Fan did not care about the two people who were shocked. He rubbed his round belly and said, “I’m full. I’ll leave first.”

After saying that, he stood up and walked out of the hall.

At this moment, Zhao Haibo and Liu Gonglu came back to their senses.

They looked at Lin Fan, who was already far away, and turned to walk toward the cashier.

“Hello, we’re here to pay the bill,” Zhao Haibo said.

“Sir, you don’t have to pay for your meal with our boss,” said the waiter with a smile.

“Your boss?” Zhao Haibo frowned slightly. In the next moment, his pupils suddenly constricted, and he said, “You mean… Mr. Lin?”

“Yes,” the waiter said.

Instantly, Zhao Haibo and Liu Gonglu were stunned once again.

The biggest shareholder of Flower Stem!

The owner of the Imperial Hotel!

This…

Any one of these identities was enough to make people look up to them.

At this moment, they were focused on a young man in his 20s!

Simply…

It was simply unimaginable!

However, what they did not know was that this was only a small portion of Lin Fan’s assets.

If they knew all of his assets, what would their expressions be like?

After a while, Zhao Haibo asked with difficulty, “M-Mr. Lin is…”

“I… I don’t know either…” Liu Gonglu was stunned.

…

In reality, Lin Fan did not leave the Imperial Hotel.

Instead, he went to the presidential suite on the top floor of the Imperial Hotel, which was specially prepared for him.

After eating and drinking his fill, Lin Fan lay down on the soft bed, feeling extremely satisfied and enjoying himself.

At this moment, his phone vibrated slightly.

12:00 PM!

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received five yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 999 yuan.]

…

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received 10,000 yuan.]

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received three yuan.]

Lin Fan casually tapped on the screen and received a total of 40,211 yuan.

Just as he was about to put down his phone, a brisk ringtone rang.

It was Chu Yunyue.

“Are you free for lunch?” Chu Yunyue asked.

“You’re late. I just finished eating with my former high school classmate, Liu Gonglu,” Lin Fan said.

Chu Yunyue said, “Oh, okay. I’ve been quite busy recently. I might not be able to accompany you.”

Lin Fan said, “It’s okay. But don’t tire yourself out. Your health is the most important.”

He paused before continuing, “By the way, is it okay for you to hand over all the sales channels in the Southern Xia region to my former classmate’s company?”

Lin Fan knew that Chu Yunyue was a very ambitious person.

She had always wanted to create world-class perfumes and cosmetics.

Lin Fan did not want Chu Yunyue’s career to be affected because of him.

After all, compared to a former classmate, his lover was definitely more important.

Chu Yunyue smiled. “Don’t worry. I was planning to get a few regional agents. It’s too complicated and messy to sell through scattered channels.

“The influence and scale of Qingkong Company in the Southern Xia region are very good. It’s beneficial for us to let them be the sole agent

“You know what? Our Flower Stem’s products have already caused quite a stir in the country. If we continue to develop… becoming a top brand in the world is definitely not an extravagant hope”

Chu Yunyue started talking non-stop at the mention of the company. She sounded very excited.

When Lin Fan heard this, he broke out into a smile.

The two of them chatted for a while before hanging up.

…

When Lin Fan picked up his phone again, it was already four in the afternoon.

He slept very comfortably.

Lin Fan did not continue to drive on DiDi. Instead, he lay on the bed and played with his phone.

When he was hungry, he picked up the phone beside his bed and asked the waiter to send up a sumptuous meal.

Then, he rested for a while.

In the blink of an eye The sky turned completely dark.

Only then did Lin Fan go downstairs. He drove the Santana and walked leisurely through the streets. He would occasionally receive a DiDi order.
